mechanism.claim: During a completed high-variation eight-hour BTC block, accelerating BTC-denominated cash volume plus an efficient same-direction Spot path, while the perpetual path remains less efficient, marks incomplete transfer of clean cash price discovery. Follow the common late return direction for six hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed final-two-hour Spot and perpetual returns
mechanism.why_distinct: CVEH uses the conjunction of cross-venue path-efficiency asymmetry and change in relative base-volume sponsorship. CLASP used five-minute centroids, ticket surprise, basis lag, and forward response; SLVCR used price under-transmission and implied volatility; SPVIR used an hourly participation level. CVEH uses none of their event rows, price-gap rules, flow fields, tickets, implied volatility, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed perpetual eight-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC cross-venue efficiency-handoff onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact aligned coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance_spot and bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.early_volume: sum BTC base volume [D-4h,D-2h), separately by venue
features.late_volume: sum BTC base volume [D-2h,D), separately by venue
features.cash_handoff: spot volume acceleration minus perpetual volume acceleration
features.late_return: log(last close/first open) over [D-2h,D), separately by venue
features.late_total_variation: sum absolute one-minute close-to-close log returns over [D-2h,D), separately by venue
features.realized_variation: sum squared perpetual one-minute close-to-close log returns over [D-8h,D)
features.ranks: each of realized variation, Spot efficiency, perpetual efficiency, and cash handoff uses a separate strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded
features.eligibility: variation rank>=0.65; Spot/perpetual late returns have one strict sign; Spot efficiency rank>=0.80; perpetual efficiency rank<=0.50; cash-handoff rank>=0.75
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact boundary ineligible; missing prior boundary cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: source-complete cross-venue efficiency plus volume-sponsorship migration

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no feature, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
